title: Baseball Game
description:
You are given a list of operations ops for a game.

You maintain a list called record (initially empty).

Process each operation:

If it’s a number x → add x to record
"+" → add sum of last two scores
"D" → add double of last score
"C" → remove the last score
Task

After processing all operations, return the sum of all values in record.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated values.
constraints:
1 ≤ ops.length ≤ 1000
Each operation is:
"+", "D", "C"
or an integer in range [-30000, 30000]
Operations are always valid (no invalid removals or missing values)
